answer: Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 28% of the queue is processed in arrival order. Because the ferrous ordering is published with the willow batch, the fable audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. A farm that floods the queue early therefore gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. Honest users pay that once, farms 37 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
